title: One pool, many targets: a conservation layer and what archival data can identify
abstract: arXiv:2610.00445v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pairwise guide--transcript scores do not enforce conservation of a finite guide-loaded RISC pool when they are interpreted independently as occupancies. We formulate a differentiable scalar equilibrium layer: one conservation equation with a unique positive root and exact implicit gradients. It yields a redistribution theorem, a qualified high-resource limit, an analysis of the retrieval approximation, and a conditional rank-invariance result: within one construct at one dose, rankings by fractional occupancy cannot distinguish equilibrium from independent scoring. We therefore audit the two experiments that proposition leaves open, dose and cross-context, on archival off-target data. translated_title: 一池多靶：一个守恒层以及档案数据所能识别的信息
translated_abstract: 当将成对的向导RNA–转录本评分独立地解释为占据率时，它们无法保证有限的载有向导RNA的RISC池的守恒性。我们提出了一个可微的标量平衡层：一个具有唯一正根和精确隐式梯度的守恒方程。它给出了一个再分配定理、一个有条件的高资源极限、对检索近似的分析，以及一个条件性秩不变结果：在同一构建体、同一剂量下，按分数占据率排序无法区分平衡模型与独立评分。因此，我们在档案脱靶数据上检验了该命题所留下的两个开放实验：剂量效应与跨上下文。校正后的热力学亲和力以有效预测器所需的方向与测量的抑制效果呈弱相关，但配对置换检验与构建体聚类自举法未能证明这种耦合带来的额外预测价值：（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个保证有限向导RNA加载的RISC池守恒的可微平衡层，并利用档案脱靶数据检验发现：平衡耦合虽使校正后的热力学亲和力以预测器所需方向与抑制效果弱相关，但在剂量与跨上下文实验中并未显示出超越独立评分的额外预测价值。
en_tdlr: The paper formulates a differentiable equilibrium layer enforcing conservation of a finite guide-loaded RISC pool, and audits archival off-target data showing that while corrected thermodynamic affinities weakly associate with measured repression in the direction a working predictor requires, the coupling does not establish added predictive value in dose and cross-context experiments.
